verses.1: In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, the LORD; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you comfort me.
verses.2: Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for the LORD, the LORD, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.”
verses.3: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.
verses.4: In that day you will say, “Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Declare his doings amongst the peoples! Proclaim that his name is exalted!
verses.5: Sing to the LORD, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!
verses.6: Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel is great amongst you!”
